name: crownfall-assets
description: Builds the game's assets: unit characters and portraits from CC0 Quaternius packs, lake plants from the CC0 KayKit pack, CC0 photo-scanned ground and building textures, a CC0 sky probe, ez-tree trees and CC0 sounds.

scripts.build: node build.mjs && node characters.mjs && node portraits.mjs && node terrain.mjs && node materials.mjs && node buildings.mjs && node sky.mjs && node trees.mjs && node sounds.mjs
